Since 1976

The team was established in 1976 and includes athletes in grades 9 through 12.

Volunteer powered

Home track meets rely on family and community volunteers to run them.

501(c)(3)

The Booster Club was awarded nonprofit status in July 2026.

Around the team

Home meets take a team beyond the track.

Central's home meets rely on family and community volunteers. The track is off campus, and every meet takes people working together.
